name: Rapid7 InsightVM — Assets
description: Pull asset inventory from Rapid7 InsightVM (hostname, OS, MAC, risk score, last assessed, users, services)

fields.label: Username
fields.help: InsightVM API username (leave empty if using API key only)

fields.label: API Key
fields.help: API key generated from InsightVM console under Administration > User Management

validation_request.error_message: Could not authenticate with InsightVM. Verify your console URL and API key.

transform.expr: min(10, max(1, int(float(value or 0) / 1000))) if value else 5
{'ip': record.get('ip', ''), 'hostname': record.get('hostName', ''), 'fqdn': record.get('hostName', ''), 'device_id': value, 'display_name': record.get('hostName') or record.get('ip', '')}

{'risk_score': record.get('riskScore', 0), 'vulnerability_count': (record.get('vulnerabilities') or {}).get('total', 0), 'vulnerability_critical': (record.get('vulnerabilities') or {}).get('critical', 0), 'vulnerability_severe': (record.get('vulnerabilities') or {}).get('severe', 0), 'vulnerability_moderate': (record.get('vulnerabilities') or {}).get('moderate', 0), 'os_family': (record.get('osFingerprint') or {}).get('family', ''), 'os_vendor': (record.get('osFingerprint') or {}).get('vendor', ''), 'os_product': (record.get('osFingerprint') or {}).get('product', ''), 'os_system_name': (record.get('osFingerprint') or {}).get('systemName', ''), 'os_cpe': ((record.get('osFingerprint') or {}).get('cpe') or {}).get('v2.2', ''), 'type': record.get('type', ''), 'assessed_for_vulnerabilities': record.get('assessedForVulnerabilities', False), 'assessed_for_policies': record.get('assessedForPolicies', False), 'service_count': len(record.get('services') or []), 'user_count': len(record.get('users') or []), 'software_count': len(record.get('software') or [])}
